entries.title: Psalms 140:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:

entries.title: Psalms 140:2
segments: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.

entries.title: Psalms 140:3
segments: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders' poison is under their lips.  Selah

entries.title: Psalms 140:4
segments: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.

entries.title: Psalms 140:5
segments: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 140:6
segments: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 140:7
segments: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

entries.title: Psalms 140:8
segments: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, [lest] they exalt themselves. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 140:9
segments: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

entries.title: Psalms 140:10
segments: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.

entries.title: Psalms 140:11
segments: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

entries.title: Psalms 140:12
segments: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.

entries.title: Psalms 140:13
segments: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.
